description:
In this role you will be responsible for developing applications at customer direction. You will work closely with Technical customers to establish requirements and schedules. Coordinate efforts with other developers, plan high level architecture for solutions, code software to spec, track and resolve software defects.

 Must have at least 2 years’ experience in the following:
 
 Node.js 
 JavaScript 
 Java (with spring framework) 
 Angular 
 HTML5 
 Building mobile capabilities using Apache Cordova is a plus 
 Rapid hands-on prototyping experience
